items.title: Establish the interactive protected crypto operator
acceptance: The profile must contain no exchange credential or direct venue mutation tool.
Status, start, stop, flatten, daily-lock, and usable-limit commands must be deterministic.
The intent construction skill must emit the strict paired schema.
The profile must preserve noise-versus-edge and active-management doctrine.
The profile must define three separate evidence-gated learning lanes.
Distribution verification and all tests must pass.
evidence: Profile foundation merged on main at 9d465211369cee1eb8d8cbfa4023948ab6bba63e.
The paired gateway foundation merged on main at 9523969756d451ddc371a5d542498dadafd325ee.
Distribution verification and 9 of 9 deterministic tests passed before merge.
The deterministic client and slash-command handlers were exercised against the paper gateway smoke process.
items.notes: This item accepts source and package contracts only; it does not prove installation, activation, venue readiness, or profitability.

items.title: Implement event-triggered candidate and position workers
acceptance: Candidate events must be durable and idempotent.
Position events must preempt slower candidate and learning work.
Strict output and bounded repair must be proven.
A failed model call must create no new exposure.
items.blocked_reason: The gateway venue adapter and calibrated event contracts in GC-002 and GC-003 are not accepted.
items.notes: Do not replace event triggers with a blind one-minute polling loop.

items.title: Implement the attributable three-lane learning supervisor
acceptance: Completed trades and matured no-trade episodes must remain attributable.
Operational defects must remain quarantined from market learning.
Lesson promotion must require independent evidence and rollback.
Prompt and model treatments must be versioned.
items.blocked_reason: GCHP-002 and the gateway replay baseline in GC-003 are not done.
items.notes: The production profile must not contain a self-editing loop.
